title: DeepPUFSCA: Deep learning for Physical Unclonable Function attack based on Side Channel Analysis support
problem: Physical Unclonable Functions are vulnerable to combined challenge-response and side-channel attacks, but existing machine learning attack methods do not simultaneously leverage both information sources, missing attack opportunities.
motivation: PUF security verification requires understanding the combined threat of side-channel and challenge-response attacks to validate nonlinearity claims and physical uniqueness guarantees.
method: DeepPUFSCA combines challenge and side-channel power consumption information features during deep learning model training to attack arbiter PUFs implemented on FPGA, demonstrating that fused multi-modal information significantly amplifies attack effectiveness.
key_novelty: Deep learning attack framework uniquely combining challenge-response and side-channel information for PUF vulnerability assessment.
contributions: DeepPUFSCA deep learning model combining challenge and side-channel features for PUF attacks
Outperforms other machine learning methods including ensemble algorithms in attack accuracy
Demonstrates that side-channel information substantially boosts PUF attack performance
FPGA implementation of arbiter PUF for realistic security validation

metrics.accuracy: Outperforms other ML and ensemble methods in attack accuracy

limitations: Not discussed; evaluation limited to arbiter PUF architecture without exploring other PUF types.
primary_theme: Multi-modal deep learning attack on PUFs combining side-channel and challenge-response
